shaft_base_A3.01.finding: RCP sheets A3.01-A3.04 share the same origin for the core (hoistway / stair polygons fit A3.01 at shift <= 1 pt, coverage 1.0); floor plans do NOT: A2.01 = A3.0x - (13.1, 8.5..9.0) while A2.02 = A3.0x - (13.1, 19.5) (A2.01 and A2.02 differ by ~11 pt in y) [DERIVADO]. offset_plan_rcp L1 (13.7, 8.7) = A2.01->A3.01 is consistent
shaft_base_A3.01.A3.01_draws_shaft: no: at L1 the shafts sit above the ceiling; A3.01 has no lines at the shaft footprint (edge coverage 0.23-0.37) -> polygon at the A3.0x core position (same coords as A3.02 / A3.04)

finding_out_of_scope: A3.01 L1 FS-1 membrane polygon ('L1 FS-1 membrane under the LEVEL 2 floor') covers both hoistway footprints (and the N/S shaft footprints): hoistways pass through the L2 floor, so no floor/ceiling membrane there -> possible overcount 43.06 + 64.20 = 107.26 SF Type C (+ RC) [DERIVADO, hoistway polygons]; shaft footprints 9.58 + 7.38 SF overlap the shaft-base ceiling. Stairs W/E are already holes in that polygon.
